summary: HIVE Digital Technologies' wholly-owned subsidiary issued $130M (including underwriters' $15M option) of 0% exchangeable senior notes due 2031, guaranteed by the issuer. The notes are exchangeable into common shares at $4.83/share, a 27.5% premium over the June 25, 2026 closing price. No regular interest accrues; settlement may be cash, stock, or a combination at the issuer's option. Issuer can redeem on or after July 5, 2029 if shares trade at 130% of the exchange price for 20 days. Watch dilution if notes convert; risk-arb focuses on stock price trajectory relative to the exchange premium.
